Nova (NASDAQ: NVMI) is a globally operating company and a leading provider of innovative metrology and process control solutions for semiconductor manufacturing.With around 1,600 employees, 4 research and development centers, and 31 locations worldwide, we deliver valuable insights into the world’s most advanced industry. Sentronics is now a permanent part of the Nova family and shares the same values: innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction. The combination of Nova’s global presence and Sentronics’ advanced technology and expertise create a unique platform for growth and innovation. As part of Nova, Sentronics will fully benefit from the exciting opportunities in the rapidly evolving semiconductor industry.As Head of Product Marketing (m/f/d) at Sentronics Metrology (a Nova Company) in Mannheim, you will take on a key leadership role in driving the divisional product marketing strategy for our high-precision metrology solutions within the semiconductor industry. Your mission is to translate complex technological capabilities into clear market value, expand our footprint with key global customers, and lead the full product lifecycle in close collaboration with R&D, Sales, and Application teams.We are looking for creative minds with high ambitions who see the seemingly impossible as a challenge and love to achieve innovative breakthroughs in a global, multidisciplinary team.Please submit your application in English.For questions, feel free to contact us at talents@novami.com (https://mailto:talents@novami.com) .Responsibilities- Leading divisional product management, marketing, and application development activities- Driving the divisional product development lifecycle in close collaboration with R&D and Sales- Developing and driving competitive positioning and value propositions to enable regional sales success- Driving technical review meetings with key customers to expand Sentronics AP market share- Representing Sentronics at global trade shows, including SEMICON, and delivering speaking engagements at technology conferences- Aligning with internal and external stakeholders on customer demo development and execution- ·Aligning cross-divisional segmentation strategies with other Nova divisions- Acting as the primary representative of Sentronics/Nova across all company-wide marketing initiatives and eventsRequirements- Strong scientific background with at least a Master’s degree, preferably in Physics, Optics, or a related field- 10+ years of relevant industry experience, including at least 5 years in leading technical marketing/product management activities within the semiconductor WFE environment- Deep, hands-on expertise in metrology requirements within semiconductor fabs- Proven experience in working with key customers in the semiconductor industry (10B+ USD CapEx)- Excellent Business-English communication skills, both verbal and written- High willingness to travel internationally (up to 50%)Benefits:- Financial Wellbeing:  Receive a tax- and duty-free cash bonus of €100 per month to use flexibly through our discounts platform and with premium suppliers. Birthday gifts and other non-cash allowance bonuses are also included.- Overall Wellbeing: Enjoy a free, generous breakfast with fresh fruit, a subsidized lunch, as well as free coffee, tea, and water. You can also work up to 20 days per year from any country in Europe.- Job Security: Work for a globally leading provider in the semiconductor industry that is continuously growing and focused on long-term success.- Professional Development: Continuously develop your skills with individual training programs and our tailored learning platform.

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. You are first and foremost an exceptional photographer with deep technical and visual expertise, setting the benchmark for photographic quality, craft, and production excellence across the Studio.You lead through expertise, influence, and example, helping elevate the capabilities of the photography team while maintaining high standards across large-scale asset production. You stay up to date with industry developments and actively support AI direction, experimentation, and content generation initiatives within the Studio and broader organization, helping translate new technologies into practical production workflows.What you’ll do- Lead by exampleand continuously raise the bar for photographic quality and execution across the Studio- Execute and oversee food, product, lifestyle, and marketing photography to the highest commercial standards- Coach, mentor, and support photographersthrough feedback, knowledge sharing, and hands-on guidance to elevate overall team capability- Define, maintain, and continuously improvephotographic standards, shooting guidelines, and best practices- Work together with Studio leadership to improve production quality, studio efficiency, and scalable ways of working- Collaborateclosely with Art Direction, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to ensure strong and consistent visual execution- Support complex productionsand solve creative and technical and production challenges on set- Drive consistencyacross large asset volumes while maintaining visual excellence and operational efficiency- Actively contribute to Studio and company AI initiativesby supporting experimentation, developing practical use cases, and helping integrate AI-supported and hybrid content creation workflows- Act as a trusted expertand escalation point for photographic quality, technical decision-making, and production excellenceWhat you’ll bring- You are a seasoned photography professional with 7+ years of experience in commercial photography, ideally including food, lifestyle, product, and high-volume e-commerce content production- You demonstrate exceptional photography craft and technical excellence. Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: Payment-related ProductsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.06.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.06.2026Stellennummer: MER00044HAArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOPicture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCEYou assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions- You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives- You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools- You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility- You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions- You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices- You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language- You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team membersQualifikationenWHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE- You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field- You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development- You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)- You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps- You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog- You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment- You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure- You are fluent in English; We are seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to join our Systems Biology Department at the Institute of Biomedical Genetics (IBMG), University of Stuttgart (https://www.ibmg.uni-stuttgart.de/systems_biology/). The successful applicant will study the regulatory mechanisms of alternative splicing in health and disease using a combination of kinetic modeling, bioinformatic data analysis and/or AI. jobs.description: Job available in 2 locations: Karlsruhe, MunichWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionAre you a last year university student or recent graduate who would like to take his\her first steps within a dynamic clinical research organization? Are you interested in learning fundamental skills to start effectively your career?At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.How will you make an impact?The 6 month internship in Clinical Operations is designed to offer you the opportunity to develop insight into clinical research, master your skills while conducting meaningful work within the team. The programme framework is crafted to allow you to grow professionally, learning invaluable skills to help you kick start your career!What you will do?As part of the Clinical Operations, you will work closely as a team, providing support and ideas for day to day activities. Your engagement and level of dedication will ensure that our project teams would receive the administrative and technical support they needs. You will have a mentor who will help you navigate through our organization and processes and receive the best support, which will ensure you are on your way to reaching your goals.You will need to be in the office three days each week, with flexibility to work from home on the other days.Being part of the Clinical Operations team, you will be introduced to many diverse parts of the company and to other interns across Europe. You will have a wide portfolio of exciting tasks to complete. Plus test your natural curiosity in providing administrative and technical support to the team proactively, educating yourself about the clinical research industry and master your skills to measure your business progress.How will you get here?- You are last year university student looking for an entry level position- You have the ability to handle numerous tasks simultaneously- You enjoy working in a team- You also have excellent administration and organization skills and the ability to prioritize and time handle various tasks- Results oriented- Demonstrate a positive demeanor and desire to succeed- Exhibits a high degree of flexibility in adapting to a constantly evolving business environment- English and German proficiencyWork Environment:At PPD clinical research services we hire the best, develop ourselves and each other, and recognize the power of being one team. We understand that you will want to grow both professionally and personally throughout your career, and therefore at PPD clinical research services you will benefit from an award-winning learning and development programme, ensuring you reach your potential.Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Severely disabled applicants with the same aptitude will be given preferential treatment. / Schwerbehinderte Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt behandelt.
